title: SCAP-NG 0.4 draft unified Assessment predicates
description: Draft one-grammar Test, State, requirement and record syntax. Not yet approved; capability-specific validation and full collector selector coverage pending.

paired_requirement.description: Test-with-States, State-field, record, or record-field existence+matching requirement; generated names are draft candidates.

presence_requirement.description: State-free Test: existence only; matching aggregator is inoperative.

value_match.description: Required on arrays, Variable references and Organizational Inputs. Independent of the observed-Item/State/record requirement.

object_record_field_predicate.description: WMI/cmdlet native collector record field. One explicit comparator plus required selection_match; no existence/require hidden default.

items.description: Explicit Item-existence requirement, corresponding to OVAL check_existence (not check).
items.title: How many Items must exist

all_items_must.description: For each selected Item, these conditions must be satisfied under the OVAL check='all' aggregation; empty-set behavior is controlled separately by items.
all_items_must.title: Conditions every Item must satisfy

all_items_requirement.description: For each selected Item, verify the nested field predicates; population existence is checked independently.
all_items_requirement.title: Item existence and all-Items conditions

items.title: Required Item existence
items.description: Explicit selected-Item existence only; no States and no Item matching. The 'all' token retains the original OVAL all_exist population semantics.

item_presence_requirement.title: Item existence requirement
item_presence_requirement.description: Checks population existence without comparing State predicates; corresponds to State-free OVAL check_existence.
